webchanges — the fetch → filter → diff → report pipeline

A one-page tour of how data moves from a source through to a notification.

The pipeline at a glance

Job Filter chain Differ Diff-filter chain Report & reporter

1. Job

Fetch the raw bytes. Every job declares a single source.

  • url: + (default) — HTTP/FTP/file:// via httpx, requests, or curl_cffi. kind: url
  • url: + use_browser: true — Playwright-driven Chrome/Firefox/WebKit; renders JS. kind: browser
  • command: — local shell command output. kind: command

2. filters:

Transform the fetched bytes before storing & comparing. Chained, applied in order.

  • Select: css, xpath, element-by-{id,class,style,tag}
  • To text: html2text, csv2text, pypdf, pdf2text, ical2text, ocr
  • Reformat: beautify, absolute_links, format-json, jsontoyaml, format-xml, pretty-xml, jq
  • Edit: between, keep_lines_containing, delete_lines_containing, re.sub, re.findall, strip, striplines, sort, reverse, remove_repeated
  • Encode/hash: sha1sum, sha256sum, hexdump, ascii85, base64
  • Escape hatch: execute (any program), shellpipe (avoid)

3. differ:

Compare new vs. previous snapshot and produce the diff text. One per job.

  • unified — line-by-line, unified format (default)
  • table — unified-style diff rendered as an HTML table
  • wdiff — word-by-word
  • deepdiff — structural compare for JSON / XML
  • command — pipe to an external diff program
  • ai_google — Gen-AI summary (BETA)
  • image — overlay visual diff (BETA, pairs with ascii85 filter)

4. diff_filters:

Post-process the diff text before it goes into the report. Chained.

  • Any filter from stage 2 can be re-used here (e.g. delete_lines_containing: "@@")
  • additions_only — keep only added lines (with a shrink-safeguard threshold; unified differ only)
  • deletions_only — keep only deleted lines (unified differ only)

5. Report → Reporter

All jobs' diffs are bundled into a report in one of three formats and dispatched.

  • text — Unicode plaintext
  • html — colorised, clickable
  • markdown — for chat reporters

Each reporter inherits one of these three formats — see below.

Gotchas

  1. URLs must be unique per job. If you really need to monitor the same URL twice, append #tag (or set user_visible_url) — otherwise jobs collide silently in the snapshot DB.
  2. YAML is fussy. Spaces only (no tabs); a space is required after every :; lines starting with -, %, : , brackets, or containing  # need quoting. The "Unknown filter kind" error is almost always a missing space after a colon. (YAML primer)
  3. Prefer an API to use_browser: true. Browser jobs are CPU/RAM-heavy and run with a much smaller worker pool. Inspect DevTools → Network for an underlying JSON endpoint first.
  4. use_browser: true can't fetch PDFs. Use a plain url job + pypdf / pdf2text filter instead.
  5. Filter order matters. Filters are applied in list order — e.g. html2text before re.sub means the regex sees plain text, not HTML.
  6. diff_filters see diff syntax, not your data. A delete_lines_containing: "@@" strips unified-diff hunk headers; a re.sub here can mangle the leading +/- markers if you're not careful.
  7. additions_only / deletions_only are unified-only. They're shortcuts that operate on the unified-format diff stream; combining them with differ: deepdiff/table/wdiff/image/ai_google won't do what you expect.
  8. additions_only: true still surfaces big drops. If new content shrinks to ≤25% of old (default safeguard), deletions are shown anyway with a warning. Tune with a numeric ratio or "disable_safeguard".
  9. "Deletion + identical addition" usually means a link changed — visible text is the same but an underlying href moved. Run with --verbose if surprised.
  10. stdout is on by default. If you only want Telegram/email, set report.stdout.enabled: false in config.yaml.
  11. Reports are sorted alphabetically by job name, not by completion order. Use the value of the name: directive to control display order.
  12. Conditional requests can mask updates on broken servers. webchanges sends If-Modified-Since / If-None-Match by default; for the rare site that mishandles 304s (e.g. Google Flights), add no_conditional_request: true. (details)
  13. Cloudflare / Akamai / JA3 walls need http_client: curl_cffi. The default httpx (and requests) backends are detected at the TLS handshake and may get 403s, 429s, or CAPTCHAs even on pages a real browser loads fine. curl_cffi wraps libcurl-impersonate and replays a real browser TLS/HTTP-2 fingerprint at the wire level — much lighter than use_browser: true. Install with uv pip install webchanges[curl_cffi], then pick the profile via impersonate: chrome|safari17_0|firefox133|… (default chrome); use the fingerprints: directive for raw ja3 / akamai / extra_fp overrides. The impersonate and fingerprints directives are silently ignored by the httpx and requests backends. (http_client, impersonate)
  14. Many features are pip extras. browser, ocr, pdf2text, jq, deepdiff, matrix, telegram, xmpp, etc. all need uv pip install webchanges[…]. (list)
  15. Time zone defaults to the host's — if running on a UTC cloud box, set report.tz in config.yaml (IANA name).
  16. Newly added jobs flood the first run as "NEW". Use webchanges --prepare-jobs to seed snapshots without touching existing jobs.
  17. Trailing-newline / encoding diffs. Adding strip at the end of a filter chain prevents spurious "changed" reports caused by trailing whitespace differences.
  18. Editor autocompletion may need a hint comment. Add # yaml-language-server: $schema=jobs.schema.json at the top of each YAML document (job) for IDE validation.
